"So I've been planning to rebuild many of my momentum skills.  Highest priority is Sprint-Dev for multiple reasons, one is that I'm very unhappy with how the workflow works within the skill, and second because I want to incorporate our momentum custom agents that use hot constitution, AGENT.md files and KB. Once it passes it merges the worktrees into the sprint branch and runs an avfl which also might make a lot of sense as a dynamic workflow, once that has finished the final loop, e2e validation and fix is run.  Currently that is done using TeamCreate but that isn't working well at all and I'd like to remove it and replace it with another type of validate and fix loop.  The final step of sprint-dev is a HITL review of all the work done.  I've manually been asking for an HTML report like this one: file:///Users/steve/projects/momentum/.momentum/handoffs/sprint-2026-05-26-hitl-report.html, but I'd like to formalize that and and maybe add a template. Do they have a natural loop capability?"

There should be one or more agents that communicates to Gemini using our CHROME MCP tools and uses existing sign in.  But also a number of discovery agents to scour the web.  This is EXTRAORDINARILY important topic and it's extrememly important that we try to get the latest information, studies, blog articles, technical white papers on the subject from May 31 2026.  DO NOT RELY on training data.  The topic is the sweet spot for HITL communication.  Is there a level at which the HITL should be making decisions and where they should leave details to the LLM?  Should EVERY decision by the LLM be exhaustively reviewed or can we rely on the LLM to make certain decisions well and review at a higher level? Think in terms of planning and reviewing afterwards.  Must I review every word, every line of code, etc of every plan and every output artifact, or can an LLM be relied on to make good decisions at a certain point?
